name: Emilio Aguinaldo
role: Filipino revolutionary leader and first president of the Philippines (1899-1901)
summary: Aguinaldo led the Philippine revolution against Spain and then the war against the United States, setting up a dictatorial and then a republican revolutionary government. The sources read here record his case for national independence and his readiness to fight for it, and little about economic, social or ecological questions.
